proof_audit: Positive finite state prices directly exclude arbitrage; physical laws remain separate. Trading is explicitly date 0/T for stock, with deterministic bank borrowing/reinvestment at all payment dates.

Compact closed probability set, support-elimination directions and finite convex splitting prove one/two-state extremal laws, including repeated stock prices and singleton states at the forward. Strict interior forward ensures the average of listed laws is positive.

Coercive piecewise affine stock-hedge envelope attains its optimum at an intersection. Active slopes straddle zero, giving matching state-law expectation and exact primal/dual equality without invoking untaught LP duality.

Strict positivity excludes both endpoints of a nonaffine payoff price range; positive baseline mixing obtains every interior price. Collapsed interval implies pointwise replication. Endpoint arbitrages and changed physical support/trading constraints are explicit.

Weighted independent Brownian cross variation proved by conditional zero means and L2 bounds; same-driver square deviations and elementary-integral approximation give the required vector covariance. Localized vector C1,2 Ito proof controls coefficient freezing, drift terms, Taylor remainder and stopping-time discontinuity.

Two-driver factor exposure is a local rank result with conditional residual variance and a precise missing driver, not a factor-count slogan or global completion theorem. An added option needs nonzero factor loading and global admissibility not furnished by pointwise linear algebra.

Bounded positive volatility sigma(y)=.20+.05 tanh(y) gives an explicit positive exponential stock. Constant tilt on independent second Brownian coordinate is proved via normal density factorization; stopped S2 integral bound, elementary Gronwall iteration and Fatou give true L2 stock martingales under every stated measure. Two different digital expectations exclude common admissible replication.

Candidate stochastic-factor PDE is a verification drift equation with terminal/martingale hypotheses, not an unproved existence/Feynman-Kac theorem or arbitrary stochastic-risk-premium measure construction.

Finite deterministic event grid jump formula follows by scalar Ito on continuous pieces and exact endpoint telescoping. Gains use pre-event holdings, finite jump remainder is exact and gamma approximation qualified. No general random-time compensator/Levy result is assumed.

Monitoring payoff ordering is pathwise under a common law and nested observation sets; no convergence rate or arbitrary new-fixing Asian ordering claimed. Intermediate lab marks are not tradable quotes, preventing invalid dynamic martingale inference.

Credit value uses each cash date, strict earlier-coupon accrual, default-before-coupon ordering, settlement delay and distinct reference recovery versus seller paid fraction. Terminal accumulation permits bank borrowing but makes no intermediate solvency guarantee.

Fair-spread ratio extrema use convex combinations weighted by positive annuities. Nonconstant ratios have excluded positive-law endpoints via the linear payoff gap; zero annuity is explicitly outside the bounded lab and treated as a conceptual boundary.
